LESSON: ROLES OF CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Foundations of Creative Arts and Sports
Topic 1.1: Roles of Creative Arts and Sports

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Roles of Creative Arts and Sports
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What is the importance of Creative Arts and Sports in society?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the roles of Creative Arts and Sports in society
2. appreciate the role played by Creative Arts and Sports in society

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: describe the roles of Creative Arts and Sports in society

Teach
• Today’s focus: describe the roles of Creative Arts and Sports in society.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “describe the roles of Creative Arts and Sports in society” using a school example.
• Model B for “describe the roles of Creative Arts and Sports in society” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "describe the roles of Creative Arts and Sports in society" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: appreciate the role played by Creative Arts and Sports in society

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate the role played by Creative Arts and Sports in society.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “appreciate the role played by Creative Arts and Sports in society” using a home/county example.

Try this

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe the roles of Creative Arts and Sports in society
• Model 2: appreciate the role played by Creative Arts and Sports in society

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe the roles of Creative Arts and Sports in society
2. Practise: appreciate the role played by Creative Arts and Sports in society

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is the importance of Creative Arts and Sports in society?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe the roles of Creative Arts and Sports in society
• appreciate the role played by Creative Arts and Sports in society
